reviewer_spec.description: Gemma 4 12B run locally through Ollama, as an agent in Claude Code (claude -p): the same harness, tools and isolation as claude-code-sonnet5, with Claude Code sending its requests to Ollama's Anthropic-compatible API. The model is gemma4:12b with num_ctx fixed at 262144 to match the gemma4-12b reviewer (build it from modelfiles/gemma4-12b-256k.Modelfile). Read-only file tools, no web access; Ollama's defaults otherwise.

input_spec.description: The same as fulltext, except that the dataset's extracted full text is a file, paper.txt, in the reviewer's working folder instead of being in the message, for an agent to open and search with its tools. Only claude-code reviewers can be given it.
